segments.text: This

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: is a place of promise, a way of life and hope for the future. Here we harvest God's gifts from above and below. Here we give thanks for our blessings, celebrate our heritage, honor tradition. Here we salute the flag and honor those who fought for it. This is our land, our people, our Kentucky.
And

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: this is where Rand Paul lives, works, raises his family, and serves our community. From Bowling Green to Paducah, Glasgow to Lexington, Corbin and Louisville, Rand Paul has provided free eye surgery for uninsured patients, and Rand Paul restores the gift of sight to God's newest creation. Rand

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06
segments.text: never forgot how sad it was for him to watch his grandmother lose her vision,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_08

cemented

segments.text: in him, the desire to be an ophthalmologist. One of the most gratifying things for Rand in his career has been the ability to do eye surgery on children from Guatemala. Being a physician gives Rand a unique perspective in Washington, simply because he's trained to diagnose a problem and find a solution.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_11
segments.text: Today, we need solutions more than ever to stop Washington and restore liberty.

Paul.

segments.text: Most people in Lexington, most people really in Kentucky want someone who will stand up against the president's policies. If you could have just one constitutional amendment, what would it be?
Term limits. Rand Paul is

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_28
segments.text: standing with us. This is our country, built by our forefathers, not government. This is our home,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_30

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_30
segments.text: These are our freedoms, given to us by God, not man. And this is our champion.
Rand
